introduction: Find the city inn's local requests, the wizard's independent commissions and the medicine-and-pendant chain. Current supplies, optional preparation and accepted delivery history stay distinct. Supporting maps, medicine, equipment and paid practice grant no extra quest achievements. Active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: The city has ordinary sea-wall, mesa, bay and north/south road approaches. Start with look and exits, then find the inn and market. Arrival discovers a place; it does not complete any named delivery.

The hungry mercenary needs the exact city loaf. The baker stocks it and the inn kitchen has a ground supply. Other food belongs to the homeless child's different, currently unsupported typed-food request.

The inn monk needs three different toy instruments together. The elven child carries the flute, the human the mandolin and the halfling the lyre; two descriptions name the wrong toys. The travelling bard's ordinary loan instruments are not valid substitutes.

The dining-room storyteller signs the large blank book, without requiring the quill mentioned in her dialogue. Inspect an accessible desk in the library; search hidden contents, then take the actual book. Examining, searching and carrying are separate actions.

The inn ranger calls his lost wolf pup Phobos and points under a bed, but the current source is a plant sack. Return the exact pup for belt and cloak. A living pet, follower, generic wolf or pet-shop claim ticket does not substitute.

The inn herbalist explains nightshade and mandrake. Open an accessible plant sack before searching; a successful ordinary search reveals one hidden object at a time, and you still need to take it. Similar sacks can hold different contents, so check the live source.

Bring the two different herbs together to the kitchen alchemist for a maroon vial. That preparation service supports the wounded halfling without adding an achievement. A supplied vial skips the herbs and does not fabricate their gathering or production history.

The wounded halfling wants the vial and the merchant's solid-gold pendant together. The merchant wears the pendant and has two bodyguards; his dialogue refuses help. The wounded halfling's heirloom claim is disputed. Acceptance lets him leave and awards experience and an empty pouch, without an escort or separate healing outcome.

The travelling bard exchanges shared blank paper for a city map. Paper exists in the active world and is declared in desks and the wine merchant's inventory. City directions, level advice and instrument loans remain supporting information, without learned-topic or performance credit.

The sorcerer's stair-bottom portal leads into the twisted tower's first chamber, where a glowing bookshelf holds the twisted-tower wizard's crumpled note. The return portal leads to the park. The note commission, magical-text commission and foreign-dagger commission are independent.

The conjurer-tower bookshelf supplies the magical text book. Royal-bedroom chest stock is another declaration, but its loaded lock has no ordinary key. The text reward is a tome and raven feather quill; other blank, signed or spell books are different items.

The twisted-tower wizard accepts Tezcat's bloody sacrificial dagger for a disguise kit, illusion robe and potion. A foreign Tezcazul carries the proof. This local delivery does not prove your own defeat of that carrier or use of the reward powers.

The dwarven warrior improves four exact ordinary weapon families. Two same-named two-handed swords are alternative inputs for one support service. Unwield the selected weapon before offering; practice, generic weapon names and other finished weapons do not substitute.

The apprentice sorcerer's one-platinum wand purchase and several city paid services are unavailable until their payments can be completed safely. A visible fee or available cash is not a completed purchase.

Dungeon exploration has a brick switch, hidden passages and actual keyed doors. Push the brick at the jail stair landing to unblock its eastern secret route, then search for the passage. This access action is not an inn-quest achievement. Rooftops and drop-offs have real falling hazards.

Exact supplied proofs remain valid. Current item checks do not prove first acquisition, personal recovery, combat, search success, learned topics, healing, practice or travel. Only accepted native delivery receipts complete these eight independent outcomes; active sources and recipient appearances still need qualification.

contacts.name: Temple knight
contacts.description: Temple of the Knight. Faith and ascending advice is ambient dialogue, without a learned-topic achievement.

contacts.name: Homeless child
contacts.description: Traditionally accepts any food for 33 experience, then leaves. This food-assistance exchange is currently unavailable. The hungry mercenary needs a different, exact loaf.

contacts.name: Brothel recipient
contacts.description: Two optional ticket branches with distinct exact results; no quest achievement or inferred disease state.

contacts.name: Zaberetornaz
contacts.description: Deep in the twisted tower. Ask about note, text and wares; three independent commissions and ordinary shop stock remain separate.

contacts.name: Khira
contacts.description: Conjurer tower. Her book topic points toward Zaberetornaz and a magical-text source. General teaching is a separate service.

contacts.name: Ithilin
contacts.description: Inn corner room. Map and city directions, borrowed instruments, bard advice and level guidance; blank paper buys a map, without a performance milestone.

contacts.name: Zech
contacts.description: Inn corner room. Four weapon-improvement families, with two alternative same-named two-handed inputs. General dwarf training advice is not accepted skill credit.

contacts.name: Arkelyn
contacts.description: Inn shop. Use arkeln as his command name. Bring all three different toy instruments together for copper and experience; the exchange does not grant a new skill.

contacts.name: Halfling child
contacts.description: By the inn. A source for the bamboo lyre, although his description names a flute. Check the actual item before collecting it.

contacts.name: Human child
contacts.description: By the inn. Carries the small clumsy mandolin, different from Ithilin's borrowed instrument.

contacts.name: Elven child
contacts.description: By the inn. A source for the reed flute, although her description names a lyre. These toys differ from the bard's borrowed instruments.

contacts.name: Xero
contacts.description: Inn common room. Food and mercenary conversation leads to the exact city bread delivery. Jungle hunting tales do not create a trap or a separate accepted hunt.

contacts.name: Leodra
contacts.description: Inn dining room. Her adventure and search advice points to a blank book; the current autograph exchange consumes only that book, without a quill.

contacts.name: Chiln
contacts.description: Outside the inn dining room. Wound and medicine story asks for a maroon vial and disputed gold pendant together; the empty pouch is a narrative twist, and acceptance retires him.

contacts.name: Thera
contacts.description: Inn guest bedroom. Her plant, nightshade, mandrake and Nebble topics explain medicine supplies. Search her accessible sack for actual hidden contents.

contacts.name: Nebble
contacts.description: Inn kitchen. Two exact herbs become a maroon vial. Laboratory and drider-antidote advice remains background without another local ending.

contacts.name: Suspicious merchant
contacts.description: Outside the inn dining room. Wears the solid-gold pendant and is followed by two bodyguards. His guard and theft replies do not offer a peaceful pendant exchange.

contacts.name: Menae
contacts.description: Inn guest bedroom. Offers a practice wand for one platinum. The purchase is currently unavailable; carrying unrelated items does not complete payment.

contacts.name: Rhed
contacts.description: Inn room three. Wolf, dog and search topics describe Phobos. Return the exact pup item for belt and cloak; no live-pet follower or rescue event is implemented.

contacts.name: City baker
contacts.description: Market bakery. Stocks the exact city loaf accepted by Xero. Ordinary shop hours, price and availability remain service rules.

contacts.name: Jelian
contacts.description: City wine shop. Declared inventory includes shared paper; inspect actual sale stock rather than assuming every carried object is produced by the shop.

contacts.name: Brothel manager
contacts.description: Declared source of tickets and the sheath. Its random bartender quests remain a separate system.

contacts.name: Town crier
contacts.description: City announcements describe local places and foreign rumors. Some advertised services differ from actual implementations; announcements are leads, without quest milestones.

contacts.name: Kabanon
contacts.description: On the mesa. City rumors call him a map seller, but no working ordinary map purchase was found. His map stock and level advice are separate from the bard's paper exchange.

contacts.name: Jodnan
contacts.description: Town tradeskill trainer. Choose forge, mine or craft, or ask about an epic-paid tradeskill reset. Lessons are separate from the city's quest deliveries.

contacts.name: Guild founder
contacts.description: Founding services use a separate confirmation and fee path. Guild creation does not complete an inn delivery or zone story.

stories.title: Xero's meal and hunting tales
stories.summary: Ask Xero about food or his mercenary life. Bring the city's loaf of bread for olyx-hide boots. His jungle and hunting stories are leads, without a deer trap or personal hunt requirement.

steps.text: Carry the city loaf of bread
steps.hint: The baker in the market stocks this loaf, and the inn kitchen has a ground supply. Other food fits the homeless child's separate request, not this exact exchange. Supplied bread also qualifies.

steps.text: Give the loaf to Xero
steps.hint: Find Xero in the inn common room. Acceptance gives durable olyx-hide boots; hunting conversation does not complete another quest.

stories.title: Arkelyn's three noisy instruments
stories.summary: Recover the children's small reed flute, clumsy mandolin and bamboo lyre together for Arkelyn. His command name is arkeln. The actual reward is 10,000 copper and 1,500 experience; the promised lesson is not a recorded skill change. The travelling bard's borrowed instruments are different items.

steps.text: Carry the small reed flute
steps.hint: The elven child by the inn carries the actual flute, although the child description names a lyre. Check the actual item. The travelling bard's ordinary flute is different.

steps.text: Carry the small clumsily made mandolin
steps.hint: The human child by the inn carries this toy. The ordinary mandolin from the travelling bard's instrument bag does not satisfy Arkelyn.

steps.text: Carry the small bamboo lyre
steps.hint: The halfling child by the inn carries the actual lyre, although the description names a flute. All three different toy items must be carried together; duplicates do not replace another kind.

steps.text: Return all three toys to Arkelyn
steps.hint: Use the actual arkeln alias at the inn shop. Exact supplied toys qualify without a personal child encounter or performance. Acceptance alone completes this collection.

stories.title: Leodra's signed adventure book
stories.summary: Ask Leodra about her adventures or a book. Find the large blank book in a desk, then return it for her autographed copy. Her dialogue mentions a quill, but the exchange requires only the book.

steps.text: Carry the large blank book
steps.hint: The library desk is a source lead. Search an accessible desk to reveal hidden contents, then take the actual book. Desks and their contents can move, so inspect current stock. Searching alone does not carry the book. Gifts are valid.

steps.text: Bring the blank book to Leodra
steps.hint: Find Leodra in the inn dining room. Her autograph replaces the blank book with a different object; no quill, conjurer class or prior adventure is required.

stories.title: Rhed's lost pup, Phobos
stories.summary: Ask Rhed about his wolf or dog, then return Phobos for a hunting belt and forest cloak. The pup is the exact small black wolf-pup item. This delivery does not create a living follower, revive an animal or complete a pet-shop claim.

steps.text: Carry the small black wolf pup
steps.hint: The inn herbalist's plant sack is the source, despite Rhed's under-the-bed clue. Open an accessible sack, search for hidden contents and take the pup. The travelling bard has another similar sack; inspect its actual contents. A supplied pup remains valid.

steps.text: Return Phobos to Rhed
steps.hint: Find Rhed in inn room three. Acceptance gives a cured leather hunting belt and heavy forest cloak. Rhed stays, and no pet purchase or rental is required.

stories.title: Chiln's medicine and disputed heirloom
stories.summary: Ask Chiln about his wound and help. The inn herbalist's nightshade and mandrake can become the kitchen alchemist's maroon medicine; Chiln accepts that vial together with the merchant's solid-gold pendant. The accepted exchange gives 3,000 experience and an empty money pouch and lets Chiln leave. Medicine preparation is optional when the vial is supplied.

steps.text: Optional history: have the kitchen alchemist prepare the medicine
steps.hint: The kitchen alchemist's herb exchange is a supporting service, not another quest achievement. Its receipt explains one vial source but does not replace a spent vial or prove personal gathering.

steps.text: Optional preparation: carry nightshade
steps.hint: Open and search an accessible plant sack. The inn herbalist explains nightshade, mandrake and the kitchen alchemist; the sack supplies hidden plants. You may instead bring a supplied final vial.

steps.text: Optional preparation: carry mandrake roots
steps.hint: This separate root batch and nightshade go to the kitchen alchemist together. Previous preparation history does not supply missing roots. The final Chiln exchange does not require carrying these herbs.

steps.text: Carry the thick maroon medicine vial
steps.hint: The kitchen alchemist makes this vial from the two plants. A supplied vial works without its producer receipt. Other potions and the apprentice sorcerer's wand do not satisfy Chiln.

steps.text: Carry the heavy solid gold pendant
steps.hint: The suspicious merchant outside the inn dining room wears the pendant and has two bodyguards. His conversation refuses help; it does not hand over the pendant. Recover the actual carried item through a valid route, or use supplied proof.

steps.text: Give the vial and pendant together to Chiln
steps.hint: The merchant accuses Chiln of theft. The reward pouch has no declared contents; Chiln leaves after acceptance. The receipt records the delivery, without a separate healing or escort outcome.

stories.title: Zaberetornaz's misplaced note
stories.summary: Ask Zaberetornaz about his note. The crumpled note in a glowing bookshelf buys a spellbook and glowing quill. This is an independent commission, without a required the conjurer briefing or earlier wizard quest.

steps.text: Carry the crumpled note
steps.hint: The glowing bookshelf in the twisted tower's first chamber holds the note. The sorcerer's stair-bottom portal leads into that chamber; another portal returns to the park. Take the note from its container, or bring a supplied copy.

steps.text: Return the note to Zaberetornaz
steps.hint: Find the wizard deeper in the twisted tower. His ordinary shop and the two other deliveries are separate. Entering the portal and asking note do not complete the commission.

stories.title: Zaberetornaz's magical text
stories.summary: The conjurer's book topic points toward Zaberetornaz. Deliver the exact magical text book for a mysterious tome and raven-feather quill. The crumpled-note reward and the dining-room storyteller's blank or signed books do not substitute.

steps.text: Carry the magical text book
steps.hint: The conjurer-tower bookshelf supplies the text. More copies may be in the royal-bedroom chest, whose loaded lock has no ordinary key. Look for an accessible bookshelf; supplied texts remain valid.

steps.text: Deliver the magical text to Zaberetornaz
steps.hint: The receipt gives a mysterious tome and a raven feather quill. The conjurer conversation and other wizard commissions are guidance, without mandatory history or a learning achievement.

stories.title: Zaberetornaz's foreign dagger
stories.summary: Bring Zaberetornaz the bloody sacrificial dagger from Tezcat. It buys a disguise kit, flowing robe of illusions and strange glowing potion. The foreign recovery route does not relocate this city delivery's credit or require your own defeat of its carrier.

steps.text: Carry the bloody sacrificial dagger
steps.hint: A Tezcazul follower in Tezcat's sacrificial altar room carries this exact dagger. The dwarven warrior's thin steel dagger is different. Unequip the proof for offering; gifts also qualify.

steps.text: Deliver the foreign dagger to Zaberetornaz
steps.hint: Receive the equipment reward. It does not record using a disguise, casting an illusion, killing the carrier or finishing either of the wizard's book commissions.

stories.title: Nebble's two-herb medicine
stories.summary: Bring nightshade and mandrake roots together to Nebble for the thick maroon vial. This preparation service supports the wounded halfling's larger delivery, without a separate achievement or daily objective. His laboratory and drider-antidote advice has no additional accepted ending here.

steps.text: Carry the clump of nightshade
steps.hint: The inn herbalist explains the plant; open and search an accessible sack, then take the actual herb. Search reveals contents but does not collect them.

steps.text: Carry the batch of mandrake roots
steps.hint: The inn herbalist's sack also has this different hidden plant. One herb or two copies of the same kind do not satisfy the recipe; supplied ingredients are valid.

steps.text: Have Nebble prepare the maroon vial
steps.hint: Find Nebble in the inn kitchen. Acceptance produces the exact vial and leaves him present. No druid, sorcerer or alchemist class is required.

stories.title: Ithilin's paper-for-map service
stories.summary: Ask Ithilin about Tharnadia or a map. Give one blank paper for a city map. The paper is an active shared item; it is not missing from the world. This orientation service grants no achievement or daily credit.

steps.text: Carry a blank piece of paper
steps.hint: Library desks and the wine merchant's declared inventory supply ordinary paper. Check current accessible contents; searching and examining alone do not collect it. Use ordinary paper; a written note or claim ticket may have another purpose.

steps.text: Give the paper to Ithilin
steps.hint: Find the travelling bard in the inn corner room. His instrument loan and conversation about music are separate from this accepted map exchange.

stories.title: Menae's practice-wand service
stories.summary: Menae offers a practice wand for 1,000 copper, described as one platinum. This coin-only preparation service is currently unavailable until its payment and reward can be completed safely. It is not a quest achievement or a recorded magical lesson.

steps.text: Complete the supported paid wand exchange
steps.hint: Find Menae in the inn guest bedroom. This purchase is currently unavailable; the displayed price does not complete payment. Item readiness checks cannot establish funds or completed payment.

stories.title: The brothel ticket service
stories.summary: The brothel offers two ticket exchanges: ticket plus sheath gives three experience; ticket alone gives a wearable penalty item. Both remain optional services without quest or daily credit. The penalty object is not evidence of a recorded disease state.

steps.text: Carry the brothel ticket
steps.hint: The brothel manager carries the ticket. Check the manager's available stock; supplied tickets are also valid.

steps.text: Optional alternative: carry the sheath
steps.hint: This item selects the separate two-item branch when offered with a ticket. It is not required for the ticket-only branch; neither branch is an achievement.

steps.text: Complete either ticket branch
steps.hint: Bring a ticket and, for the other option, the sheath too. The two exchanges have different results and do not add a quest achievement.

stories.title: Zech's long steel sword service
stories.summary: Zech exchanges the exact ordinary long steel sword for a sharpened long steel sword. This equipment improvement is a support service, without achievement or daily credit. It does not teach a weapon skill or accept every similarly named weapon.

steps.text: Carry the exact ordinary long steel sword
steps.hint: Starter-equipment awards supply this ordinary weapon. You may also bring one supplied by another player. Unwield the selected weapon before offering.

steps.text: Have Zech improve the exact weapon
steps.hint: Find Zech in the inn corner room. He stays after the exchange. Neither practice history nor the other weapon services are prerequisites.

stories.title: Zech's two-handed sword service
stories.summary: Zech exchanges the exact ordinary two-handed sword for a sharp two-handed sword. This equipment improvement is a support service, without achievement or daily credit. It does not teach a weapon skill or accept every similarly named weapon.

steps.text: Carry the exact ordinary two-handed sword
steps.hint: Starter-equipment awards are one source. Either supported ordinary two-handed sword works, and a supplied sword also qualifies. Unwield it before offering.

steps.text: Have Zech improve the exact weapon
steps.hint: Find Zech in the inn corner room. He stays after the exchange. Neither practice history nor the other weapon services are prerequisites.

stories.title: Zech's thin steel dagger service
stories.summary: Zech exchanges the exact ordinary thin steel dagger for a sharpened thin steel dagger. This equipment improvement is a support service, without achievement or daily credit. It does not teach a weapon skill or accept every similarly named weapon.

steps.text: Carry the exact ordinary thin steel dagger
steps.hint: Starter-equipment awards supply this ordinary weapon. You may also bring one supplied by another player. Unwield the selected weapon before offering.

steps.text: Have Zech improve the exact weapon
steps.hint: Find Zech in the inn corner room. He stays after the exchange. Neither practice history nor the other weapon services are prerequisites.

stories.title: Zech's thick short sword service
stories.summary: Zech exchanges the exact ordinary thick short sword for a sharp short steel sword. This equipment improvement is a support service, without achievement or daily credit. It does not teach a weapon skill or accept every similarly named weapon.

steps.text: Carry the exact ordinary thick short sword
steps.hint: Starter-equipment awards supply this ordinary weapon. You may also bring one supplied by another player. Unwield the selected weapon before offering.

steps.text: Have Zech improve the exact weapon
steps.hint: Find Zech in the inn corner room. He stays after the exchange. Neither practice history nor the other weapon services are prerequisites.

exclusions.reason: The homeless child accepts any food type rather than an exact durable item. Keep this support request excluded and its active-accounting refusal until typed offering admission and recipient retirement are qualified.
